# Joshua Francis — Credibility-First Websites for Premium Brands

> Joshua Francis is a Toronto-based designer and developer who designs and builds credibility-first websites for premium service brands. As one accountable owner across design and build, he makes a business look as established as it already is, so the right clients take it seriously and it can hold its prices. His background spans enterprise AI (Agent Designer at PolyAI), product design, and finance at BMO.

## About

- [About Joshua Francis](https://joshuafrancis.ca/about): Background across finance (BMO), enterprise AI (PolyAI, Synthminds), and product design, and how that range shapes the work.
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Works with clients across Canada and the United States, remote and on-site in the Greater Toronto Area.
- Offer: One owner, design and build. A strategy-led website rebuild that makes proof, positioning, and reputation obvious before the first call. Not a cosmetic redesign.

## Work (case studies)

- [Shiki Studios](https://joshuafrancis.ca/work/shiki-studios-acting-school): Rebuilt the website for a Toronto acting school whose alumni appear on Netflix, Prime Video, and Paramount+. Enrollment up 41% since launch on almost no extra marketing; desktop PageSpeed 100/100 (up from 44).
- [Synthminds](https://joshuafrancis.ca/work/synthminds-brand-platform): Brand identity and web platform for an AI consulting firm serving NVIDIA, PwC, HP, and Kraft Heinz.
- [All work](https://joshuafrancis.ca/work): Full case study index.
